2026-11-26.title: Blade Runner 2099
2026-11-26.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

2026-11-26.title: Dig
2026-11-26.overview: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

2026-11-26.title: The Trials of Karen Read
2026-11-26.overview: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

2026-11-26.title: The Blue Road
2026-11-26.overview: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

2026-11-26.title: The Altruists
2026-11-26.overview: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

2026-11-26.title: The Law of Beasts
2026-11-26.overview: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

2026-11-26.title: Gordon
2026-11-26.overview: Aníbal Gordon rises from a small-time thief to a convicted murderer in Argentina during the '70s.

2026-11-26.title: Honey
2026-11-26.overview: East Berlin, 1982. Marta, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois.

2026-11-26.title: Murder in Galicia
2026-11-26.overview: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

2026-11-26.title: The Good Daughter
2026-11-26.overview: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

2026-11-26.title: Cunk on Cinema
2026-11-26.overview: Philomena Cunk asks experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

2026-11-26.title: The Body
2026-11-26.overview: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

2026-11-26.title: ChiaroScuro
2026-11-26.overview: After a body is found in a Roman museum, an art expert must apply his instincts and skills to help police solve a mystery connected to his own past.

2026-11-26.title: Under Siege
2026-11-26.overview: Caught in the crossfire, hostages, militaries and guerrillas are swept into a tragedy that brings turmoil to Colombia.

2026-11-26.title: Campus Drivers
2026-11-26.overview: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

2026-11-26.title: Sunshine through the Rain
2026-11-26.overview: Two struggling biology students, initially rivals for a scholarship, find mutual support and solace, transforming their relationship from competition to companionship.

2026-11-26.title: Anaesthesia
2026-11-26.overview: After a bold but unsuccessful surgery, a talented doctor swaps a prestigious clinic for a local hospital as he tries to get his life back on track.

2026-11-26.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway
2026-11-26.overview: Beth Holloway, Natalee's mother, tells the full, definitive story of the case that's haunted her for the past 20 years - from the day of Natalee's disappearance to the dramatic confession two decades later.

2026-11-26.title: The Remarried Empress
2026-11-26.overview: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

2026-11-26.title: Bass X Machina
2026-11-26.overview: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

2026-11-26.title: Dead-End Job
2026-11-26.overview: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

2026-11-26.title: The Traitor Within
2026-11-26.overview: The series follows the young and ambitious Henry Rinnan, and how his personal demons and narcissistic need for recognition drove him from a failed salesman to Norway’s most notorious traitor.

2026-11-26.title: A Couple of Lies
2026-11-26.overview: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.
